proof_body:
by
  intro A K _ _ _ _ _ _ p a n hp hn hpa hp2
  have hm : (Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C a : Polynomial A).Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne'
  rw [← hm.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map]
  have hP : (Ideal.span {p}).IsPrime := (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hp.ne_zero).mpr hp
  have hd : (Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C a : Polynomial A).natDegree = n := Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C
  refine Polynomial.irreducible_of_eisenstein_criterion hP ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hm.isPrimitive
  · rw [hm.leadingCoeff, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact hp.not_unit ∘ isUnit_of_dvd_one
  · intro k hk
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    have hk' : k < n := by
      rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hm.ne_zero, hd] at hk
      exact_mod_cast hk
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, if_neg hk'.ne, Polynomial.coeff_C]
    split_ifs <;> simp [hpa]
  · rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hm.ne_zero, hd]
    exact_mod_cast hn
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, if_neg hn.ne, Polynomial.coeff_C_zero, zero_sub, dvd_neg]
    exact hp2
target_source: ∀ (A K : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A] [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] (p a : A) (n : ℕ), Prime p → 0 < n → p ∣ a → ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ a → Irreducible ((Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C a : Polynomial A).map (algebraMap A K))
